rationale: C10 and C21 concern amendments to federal travel and transportation regulations, but their provisions address transferred employees, family transportation, advances, and household-goods reimbursement rather than the child's written service commitment, debt-recovery mechanism, and minimum overseas-service requirement. C03 shares the form of replacing an existing section and addresses continued federal employment status, but this is generic amendment structure applied through materially different machinery. No candidate contains distinctive language or a parallel operative sequence sufficient to show that it supplied a concrete drafting template.
